title: Learning Who Benefits Most: Multi-Treatment Causal Ranking for Population Health Stratification
abstract: arXiv:2610.19782v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Population health stratification frameworks, such as the Italian DM77, organize patients by clinical need and care pathways but offer limited guidance on which care changes to prioritize under constrained resources.   We present PROMETHEUS (Proactive Resource Optimization through Multi-treatment Effect-based Targeting in Healthcare Environments Using Stratification), a framework that formulates population health stratification as a multi-treatment causal ranking problem. Its objective is to order eligible patient-treatment opportunities by expected incremental benefit rather than obtain perfectly calibrated individual treatment-effect estimates.   Each clinically admissible care intensification is compared with maintaining the patient's current pathway. translated_title: 学习谁受益最多：面向人群健康分层的多治疗因果排序方法
translated_abstract: 人群健康分层框架（如意大利的DM77）按照临床需求和护理路径对患者进行分类，但在资源受限的情况下，对于应优先采取哪些护理调整提供的指导有限。我们提出了PROMETHEUS（通过分层在医疗环境中基于多治疗效应定位实现主动资源优化），这是一个将人群健康分层形式化为多治疗因果排序问题的框架。其目标是根据预期增量收益对符合条件的患者-治疗机会进行排序，而非获得完全校准的个体治疗效应估计。每种临床上可接受的护理强化方案都与维持患者当前护理路径进行比较。多种治疗方法被联合学习，以在共享参考条件、结果、随访时间范围和基线的领域内，生成跨患者和护理特征全局可比较的排序。
tldr: 提出PROMETHEUS框架，将人群健康分层转化为多治疗因果排序问题，通过联合学习对治疗进行全局排序，依据预期增量收益识别最应优先获得护理强化的患者，从而在资源受限条件下优化医疗资源分配。
en_tdlr: PROMETHEUS formulates population health stratification as a multi-treatment causal ranking problem, jointly learning a globally comparable ranking of patient-treatment opportunities by expected incremental benefit to guide prioritization of care intensifications under constrained resources.
